entities.name: Genghis Khan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Founder of the Mongol Empire (c. 1162–1227), the largest contiguous land empire in history. His conquests connected East and West, establishing the Pax Mongolica that enabled unprecedented trade and cultural exchange along the Silk Road.
